messages:
jordan: Quick sync: I ran a head-to-head on embed/rerank between replay harness and synthetic traffic. Noticing tail latency regressions after latest kernel selector tweak. Need to decide apples-to-apples config. Summary below. :eyes:

sara: Can you paste the config? batch heuristics + kv settings matter.

jordan: Config I used:
```
mode: replay
batching:
  heuristic: adaptive_v2
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  shard_strategy: 'per-request'
model:
  name: 'embed-psi-2'
  dim: 1024
```

mike: What's the difference vs synthetic?

jordan: Synthetic used poisson arrivals with p95 concurrency tuned to match avg rps from replay; but synthetic used uniform sequence length (128) while replay has a long tail to 1024.

nguyen: Logs?

jordan: Key numbers from the runs:
```
# replay run
p50: 18ms
p95: 120ms
p99: 420ms
kv_miss_rate: 0.12

# synthetic run
p50: 16ms
p95: 80ms
p99: 200ms
kv_miss_rate: 0.05
```

lina: So kernel selector picks kernel-A for seq<=256, else kernel-B? Did threshold change?

jordan: Yes. We switched threshold 384->256 to favor fused-kv kernels; good for common case but bad for long sequences. Repro steps:
```
./bench/replay_harness --trace=kv --replay=path/to/trace --concurrency=64 --model=embed-psi-2 --record=run1.log
```

sara: We should normalize vector dims + payload: did you keep dims constant across runs? synthetic was 768 vs model 1024?

jordan: Good catch. Synthetic used 768-dim generator. I reran with 1024 and tail improves slightly; still worse on replay. I suspect batching heuristics + kv eviction + kernel swap cause stalls.

mike: Any flamegraphs?

jordan: Attached flame (local): /logs/flame-replay-run1.svg — hotspot shows memcpy in kernel-B during p99 cases.

nguyen: Proposal:
1) sample seq length distribution from replay into synthetic
2) lock kernel selector to previous threshold for A/B runs
3) add per-request KV warmup in harness
Anyone object?

lina: :thumbsup: do it. Also add fixed payload sizes: 1KB, 4KB, 16KB.

bench-bot: perf-regression alert: commit abc123 changed kernel_selector.py:line:87. CI perf tests show +18% p99 for embed-rerank. See #ci/bench.

jordan: I'll open an RFC and patch. Assigning @sara and @mike to run controlled experiments; @nguyen to run flamegraphs. Plan smoke runs by EOD. Thx.
